recommendation_summary: Action now: on every change, assign the lead plus one of the two already-authorized engineers as approvers. Either engineer can approve and merge the same day when the lead is away. Status stays in the existing tracker, with no new tool, and the team measures ready-for-review-to-merge time on the next few changes. Optional additions: none are offered now. Squads, chapters, Jira Align and quarterly workshops are put off as a later decision. Unmet needs: none significant, though the reply has no structured decision record.
note: The backup-approver fix is sound and bounded, but none of the four required record labels appear, so every record predicate fails.
